Rae (CSM): quick flag 1 accounts showing stalled onboarding + usage drop. need a light save play focused on unblock + feedback capture.
Ibrahim (Support): what signal set? errors or milestone stop?
Rae (CSM): onboard_progress <60% AND 14d DAU decline >18%. renewals within 90d prioritized.
Ariel (Enablement): propose 30-min "unblock office hour" + 1-page checklist and a 1-click session link. cohorts of 6.
Diego (AM): for renewals <60d Ill offer seat reallocation + 30d premium trial rather than flat discounts.
Ibrahim (Support): Ill scan for accounts with >2 setup tickets and tag for eng pairing.
Rae (CSM): save-play steps: 1) outreach + calendar (Ariel) 2) triage tickets (Ibrahim) 3) concession if renewal <60d (Diego) 4) capture top_issue and verbatim feedback (Rae).
HealthBot: notes: 21 accounts flagged, avg onboard 48%, avg dau_delta -21%.
Ariel (Enablement): outreach copy draft: "Hi <Name>, noticed setup paused. 30-min office hour + checklist at no cost this week. Want a slot?"
Ibrahim (Support): triage rule: ticket_count>2 or error_tag=="integration_fail" -> eng-pair within 24h.
Diego (AM): downgrade-safe path: preserve data retention, remove nonessential premium features, include 45-day re-upgrade credit.
Rae (CSM): timelines: outreach by EOD, office hours within 7d, triage within 24h, concessions within 48h post-session. owners?
Ariel (Enablement): Ill own outreach + first wave (10).
Ibrahim (Support): Ill own triage and eng-tagging.
Diego (AM): Ill own concession proposals.
Rae (CSM): thanks. react :white_check_mark: when done. follow-up standup 48h after first wave.
